g.text: Cost and latency are design concerns here:
each agent declares a ModelTier, so simple tasks
(substitution, rationale, meal) use the fast model
and only block generation uses the stronger one.
CachingLLMClient returns a stored reply for an
identical request, which matters most when the
Stage 3 suites rerun the same scenarios.
The rest of the system depends only on the
LLMClient and Tool interfaces, so the
+complete(msgs : List<Message>, tools : List<ToolSchema>, system : String) : LLMResponse
+complete(msgs : List<Message>, tools : List<ToolSchema>, system : String) : LLMResponse
+validateBlock(b : TrainingBlock, ctx : AgentContext, s : ProgressionStrategy) : ValidationReport
+validateSubstitution(e : Exercise, allowed : List<Exercise>, r : SubstitutionReason, l : List<Limitation>) : ValidationReport
+validateMeal(m : MealSuggestion, d : DietaryConstraints, remaining : MacroTotals) : ValidationReport
+validateProgression(revised : TrainingBlock, original : TrainingBlock, r : AdherenceReport) : ValidationReport
